profile.headline: Software Developer at IBM Austin
profile.summary: Experienced developer with a demonstrated history of excelling in the logistics, supply-chain, and information technology industry with a military background. Skilled in Python, Cloud Programming, Web Development, C++, Document Management, Java, Security, Customer Service, and Data Entry.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designs, develops, tests and delivers offerings using leading edge and/or proven technologies. Works in an Agile, collaborative environment to understand stakeholder requirements. Designs, codes, and tests innovative component-level software solutions. Ensures that the implemented solutions are unit tested and ready to be integrated into their product. Also debugs customer-reported problems: designs, develops and unit tests code fixes.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · JSON · Microservices · Bash · Kubernetes

positions.title: Junior Python Developer
positions.description:
Summary - responsible for writing and testing scalable code, developing back-end components, and integrating user-facing elements in collaboration with front-end developers. Possesses in-depth knowledge of object-relational mapping, experience with server-side logic, and above-average knowledge of Python programming. Designs highly responsive web-applications that perfectly meet the needs of the client. (Currently under contract with IBM.)

Duties and Responsibilities
- Coordinating with development teams to determine application requirements.
- Writing scalable code using Python programming language.
- Testing and debugging applications.
- Developing back-end components.
- Integrating user-facing elements using server-side logic.
- Assessing and prioritizing client feature requests.
- Integrating data storage solutions.
- Coordinating with front-end developers.
- Reprogramming existing databases to improve functionality.
- Developing digital tools to monitor online traffic.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · JSON · Microservices · Bash · Kubernetes

positions.title: Shipping Manager
positions.description:
Directly responsible for ensuring all shipments reach customers in a timely fashion while minimizing
damage to product
❖ Instituted cost saving program to reduce shipping expenses; saved company $5000
❖ Provided Quality Control on all items manufactured by Production Department
❖ Coordinated and prepared shipping reports as needed.
❖ Maintained high level of customer service to all involved parties both internal and external

positions.title: Technical Service Representative
positions.description: The Technical Service Representative has various key responsibilities involved with the shipping and crossing of international borders that require certain documentation to meet the requirements of US Customs and additional Partner Government Agencies. The TSR understands the impact of this position to other business functions depend on the accuracy and efficiency of outgoing items that are required to facilitate the flow of international trade. He/she will ensure all shipments are cleared for transport and all legal obligations and documentation requirements are adhered to, and that the shipments are processed timely & accurately, while satisfying customer/client expectations.

positions.title: Associate Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
	Provided a high level of customer service by developing and maintaining a strong relationship with customers' front line personnel in the various operating divisions and subsidiaries.
	Prepared and submitted documentation to the appropriate parties, ensuring they’re in accordance with all applicable laws/regulations relating to customs and transportation.
	Anticipated, identified, and resolved problems which could delay the timely release or movement of freight. 
	Maintain relationships with correspondent brokers and other service providers to ensure that agents exceed the customers' service requirements. 
	Completed accurate data input or corrections into computer files. 
	Develop rates and/or provide quotes for the movement of freight. Research and negotiate carrier rates.

company.name: FedEx Trade Networks, Transportation and Brokerage

positions.title: Squad Leader
positions.description:
	Lead, supervised and performed security force activities in direct support of the United States Nuclear Enterprise. 
	Protected nuclear weapons systems and other critical resources.
	Operated communications equipment, vehicles, intrusion detection equipment and other special purpose equipment. 
	Applied life saving procedures as first responders to accident and disaster scenes.
	Enforced standards of conduct, discipline, and adherence to laws and directives. 
	Developed plans, policies, procedures, and detailed instructions to implement SF programs.

educations.schoolName: Community College of the Air Force

honors.description: Awarded for significant achievement in LEADERSHIP AND JOB PERFORMANCE IN PRIMARY DUTY, SIGNIFICANT SELF-IMPROVEMENT, and BASE OR COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Eagle Scout is the highest achievement or rank attainable in the Boy Scouting program of the Boy Scouts of America (BSA). The designation "Eagle Scout" was founded over one hundred years ago. Only four percent of Boy Scouts are granted this rank after a lengthy review process. The requirements necessary to achieve this rank take years to fulfill. Since its founding, the Eagle Scout rank has been earned by more than 2.5 million young men
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Dec 1995

organizations.description: ACM is a global scientific and educational organization dedicated to advancing the art, science, engineering, and application of computing, serving both professional and public interests by fostering the open exchange of information and by promoting the highest professional and ethical standards.
